name: Channels
description: The channels connected to the bot — the WhatsApp number, the Instagram account, the TikTok account, the Facebook pages and the web widget — with Disconnect, and one-press connecting for WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok: the app mints a one-shot platform link, hands the browser to the page Chatfuel serves for the platform's OAuth, and is brought back here with the channel connected. Refresh access re-grants the permissions on a channel already connected. A role without Configure: Edit sees the connection state and nothing to change.

permissions.requiredFor: reading which channels are connected to the bot
disconnecting a channel, and minting the connection and access refresh links the Connect and Refresh access buttons spend
